integrity.claim_scope: The infinite classification is proved symbolically. Exhaustive checks for \(1\le n\le12\) corroborate the proof but do not replace it.
integrity.literature_scope: The same-object scalar result is treated as prior coverage; the retained claim is only the complete minimum-set classification and its count. Failed searches are not treated as proof of novelty.

scientific_limitations: The result classifies minimum positive semidefinite zero forcing sets of the square book graph only; it does not enumerate larger PSD forcing sets.
The scalar equality \(Z_+(B_n)=2\) is explicitly prior work and is not claimed as new.
Originality is assessed against the named full-text and indexed comparisons; an unindexed or inaccessible source could contain an equivalent basis classification.
title: Minimum positive semidefinite zero forcing sets of book graphs
